parts.text: $PFE Q3 2026: revenue $16.6B, flat Y/Y, as declines in COVID products were offset by growth in Eliquis and Padcev. Operating margin 20.4%; operating cash flow $5.4B. #earnings #pharma
$ETN Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $8.9B, +28% Y/Y, driven by organic growth and strong demand across electrical markets. Operating margin 15.3%. #earnings #industrials
$KDP Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $7.3B, +71% Y/Y, driven by the JDE Peet's acquisition while legacy KDP net sales rose 8.6%. Operating margin 18.2%; operating cash flow $1.0B. #earnings #beverages
$FISV Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $5.2B, -1% Y/Y, driven by a non-cash goodwill impairment charge of $6.5B. Operating margin -105.7%; operating cash flow $1.0B. #earnings #industrials
$TEVA Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $4.4B, -2% Y/Y, as lower generics offset growth in key innovative brands. Operating margin 16.2%. #earnings #pharma
$BALL Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $4.2B, +24% Y/Y, driven by higher volume and favorable price/mix, offset by higher costs. Operating margin -2.2%. #earnings #industrials

$SHOP Q3 2026: revenue reached $3.7B, up 32% year over year, driven by expansion in merchant solutions. Operating margin was 15.2% as operating expenses increased at a slower rate than revenue. #earnings #software
$CVI Q3 2026: revenue $3.3B, +69% Y/Y, driven by higher petroleum segment volumes and refining margins. Operating margin 22.1%; net earnings $570M and operating cash flow $655M. #earnings #oil
$EXPD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $4.1B, +42% Y/Y, driven by strong airfreight tonnage and tech demand. Operating margin 10.8%. #earnings #industrials

$AME Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.2B, +17% Y/Y, driven by strong organic sales and acquisitions. Operating margin 26.3%; net earnings $426M. Company raises full year guidance. #earnings #industrials
$GPK Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $2.2B, +0% Y/Y, as volumes rose 1% but input cost inflation weighed on results. Operating margin 4.6%; operating cash flow $250M. #earnings #materials
$RACE Q3 2026: revenue of $1.9B driven by a richer sports car mix supported by the F80 and higher personalizations. Operating margin 29.7%; net earnings $431M. #earnings #autos
